$comentario_api: The backend's «no». It arrives as a code plus data —the backend does not write text for people (RN-30)— and the sentence is built here. One code per key, with the same name: api_<code>. Adding a code in the backend (app/utils/api_errors.py) without its key here makes `npm run check` fail.

$comentario_producto: When the backend sends the product id but not its name —because the row is gone— the sentence says «#47» instead of leaving a hole. And if it sends neither, «(unidentified)». The parentheses are not decoration: this text goes where a product name goes, and «the product unidentified» reads as broken English while «the product (unidentified)» reads as a name that is missing. Spanish gets away with «sin identificar» because the adjective follows the noun.

$comentario_certificado: The four reasons behind «invalid_certificate» are four sentences and not one, because what the person has to do differs in each: retype the PIN, or go find a different file. The fifth is the safety net for a reason this POS does not know yet.
api_invalid_certificate_bad_pin: The PIN does not open the certificate. Type it again.
api_invalid_certificate_not_a_p12: That file is not a .p12 certificate. The .cer the tax authority sends alongside it cannot sign.
api_invalid_certificate_no_private_key: The .p12 does not contain the private key. When exporting it, tick «include the private key».
api_invalid_certificate_no_certificate: The .p12 contains the private key but not the certificate, and without it nothing can be signed.
api_certificate_too_large: The certificate cannot exceed {kb} KB. A real one is under 5 KB: check that you uploaded the right file.
api_invalid_environment: «{environment}» is not an environment. The only ones are sandbox and production.
api_atv_user_required: Saving the password also requires the ATV user name.
api_signing_unavailable: The signing service is unavailable. Try again in a few minutes; if it persists, contact support.
$comentario_ambiente: The backend sends «sandbox» and «production», which are codes. Here they become words. They live in this catalog because today only the errors use them; once the e-invoicing screen exists (T-610) they get shared from there.
api_atv_not_configured: There is no ATV user name and password for {environment} yet. Save them before testing the connection.
api_atv_invalid_credentials: The tax authority rejected the ATV user name or password for {environment}.
$comentario_atv_unreachable: This sentence must not blame the credentials (RF-31): whoever reads «they don't work» will rotate their ATV password, and doing that on a day the tax authority is down is wasted work on a credential that was fine.
api_atv_unreachable: Could not check: the tax authority did not answer. Your credentials may well be fine. Try again in a few minutes.
api_atv_password_unreadable: The stored password for {environment} could not be read. Type it again.
api_confirmation_required: Switching to {environment} has to be confirmed.
